names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 9 aprilie, «Sfântul Cuvios Vadim, arhimandritul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 9 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Βάδιμος οσιομάρτυρας και οι επτά Μαθητές του», with the rank word and the clause naming his disciples left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

feast.note: The day page and the life page agree on 9 aprilie as the commemoration, but the life itself says he was killed «în 8 Aprilie»; the day is the calendar's, the 8th is the life's date of death.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 9 aprilie — «Sfântul Cuvios Vadim, arhimandritul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Βάδιμος οσιομάρτυρας και οι επτά Μαθητές του»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(; - 376)». The line names his seven disciples only as his seven, and the page names not one of them, so no folder was drafted for them; the companionship stands in his own life. It names their executioner, Nirsan, who had denied Christ before the torments and was afterwards killed with a knife by an idolater who grew angry with him.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr heads him «Αγιος Βαδιμος Οσιομαρτυρας Και Οι Επτα Μαθητες Του (; - 376)». The page's prose gives no year of its own, setting him only in the reign of «Σαπώρ ο Β' (325 - 379 μ.Χ.)», within which the heading's year falls.
